name: Lustful College
source:
You are a man who lost your family at an early age.

You were broke and hopeless, but then you received an acceptance letter from the most prestigious college in Japan, the Yakatato College. This college is unique in that it only admits female students from around the world. Your life is about to take a drastic turn.

As you embark on your journey at Yakatato College, you will have the opportunity to interact with the girls, engage in academic pursuits, and live life on your own terms. You can pursue romantic relationships with the characters you meet and experience a variety of adventures.

[From [url=https://tinkelstudios.itch.io/lustful-college]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年幼时便痛失家人的男子。

原本一贫如洗、走投无路的你，某天却意外收到了来自日本顶尖名门学府——馆户学院的录取通知书。这所学院最特殊的地方在于，它向来只招收来自世界各地的女学生。你的人生即将由此迎来翻天覆地的转折。

踏上馆户学院的求学之旅后，你将有机会与众多女生朝夕互动、投身学业深造，按照自己的意愿自由生活。你还可以追求途中邂逅的各色少女，亲历丰富多彩的奇妙冒险。
